test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: The municipal department has installed high-resolution surveillance cameras at major intersections.

Conclusions: I. Surveillance cameras assist in reducing traffic violations.

II. Motorists frequently ignore traffic signals at major intersections.
solution:
Given statement: The municipal department has installed high-resolution surveillance cameras at major intersections.

Given Conclusions:

I. Surveillance cameras assist in reducing traffic violations. → Follow

Installing high resolution surveillance cameras at major intersections is typically done to monitor and deter violations. It is reasonable to conduct that such cameras assist in reducing traffic violations.

II. Motorists frequently ignore traffic signals at major intersections. → Does not Follow

The statement does not imply that motorists frequently ignore traffic signals. This is an assumption beyond the given information.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
